test.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_loss_classification.py; ruff check src/financial_brain/paper/loss_classification.py tests/test_loss_classification.py; mypy src/financial_brain/paper/loss_classification.py
test.result: 8 loss-classification and evidence-registry tests passed; full Windows suite: 4185 passed, 1 skipped (796.89s); Ruff and targeted mypy passed. The durable registry binds evidence IDs to categories and artifact digests; unknown IDs and category mismatches fail closed. Artifact sources remain caller-supplied and unauthenticated.

implemented: Supports the eight requested evidence-linked reason categories and explicit UNKNOWN when a losing trade has no evidence identifiers.
Preserves one or more category/evidence-ID pairs and produces deterministic output.
Labels non-loss rows NOT_A_LOSS rather than assigning a loss cause.
Persists classifications in DuckDB with deterministic identity, idempotent replays, and conflict rejection for retroactive edits.
Revalidates persisted result contents against their evidence before writing.
Adds an append-only loss evidence registry and a verified classification path that resolves evidence IDs, enforces registered categories, and stores artifact digests with the classification.
blockers: Registered artifact hashes do not authenticate the referenced source system or establish evidence truth.
Classifier is not yet integrated into the canonical paper trade ledger or loss-review report.
Categories do not establish causal root cause; independent review and supporting data remain required.
